title: Playing Old Games
text:
Many children play traditional games. One game is hopscotch. Children draw squares on the ground with chalk. They jump from square to square.

Another game is marbles. Players use small glass balls. The player who wins gets all the marbles. Playing games is fun with friends.

questions.text: What do children draw on the ground in hopscotch?

vocabulary.definition: an activity played for fun, often with rules
shapes with four equal sides and four right angles
a soft stick used to draw on the ground or a board

paragraph_translations: Birçok çocuk geleneksel oyunlar oynar. Bir oyun seksek oyunudur. Çocuklar yere tebeşirle kareler çizer. Kareden kareye zıplarlar.
Başka bir oyun da misketlerdir. Oyuncular küçük cam toplar kullanır. Kazanan oyuncu bütün misketleri alır. Arkadaşlarla oyun oynamak eğlencelidir.
